title: ASML Holding N.V. Q2 2026 Form 6-K
excerpt: ASML reported Q2 2026 total net sales of EUR 9.3 billion and net income of EUR 2.9 billion, and raised its 2026 outlook to EUR 43-45 billion of sales with 54%-56% gross margin.
summary: The SEC filing confirms the Nasdaq-listed issuer identity and a strong Q2 operating result, materially higher full-year guidance, and continuing AI-led demand. It does not disclose a fundamental deterioration that explains the July 27-28 share-price decline.
